posts.text:
Trump’s government just gave him and his family immunity from tax prosecution. For life.

Which begs the question: What is Trump hiding in his taxes?

Video

I can’t believe I have to say this:

The President should not financially benefit from the very government he controls.

I’ve got a bill to stop Trump’s corruption.

Democrats should be talking about making child care more affordable every chance we get, going into the midterms and into 2028.

If we demonstrate how we'll actually make this care real for families—and actually fight for it—we can win.

Republicans want billions for ICE's unchecked terror—no oversight, no rules, no accountability.

I will continue to say NO.

That money could be used for:

✅ Schools & child care

✅ Healthcare

✅ Housing

✅ Jobs

Memorial Day is a special day in our family. All three of my brothers served—and I’m forever grateful they made it home safely.

To the service members who do not, we owe a debt that cannot be repaid.

No matter how you honor Memorial Day, I hope you have a meaningful day.
The President should be lowering costs, not trading stocks.

Trump sued his own IRS.

Settled with his own government.

Secured a $1.8 billion slush fund to siphon toward his allies.

Blocked the IRS audits against himself and his family. 

This is corruption in plain sight.

FOREVER BARRED.

That's the actual language that protects Trump and his family from ever having to answer for an audit of his taxes.

The corruption is staggering.

To hold onto power, Donald Trump and Republicans are trying to silence Black voters. This is all part of their plan.

Video

My Ban Presidential Plunder of Taxpayer Funds Act would make it illegal for a sitting president or VP to receive settlement payments from the federal government they control—or to direct those payments to a third party.

We CANNOT allow this abuse of power.

This is something that someone who doesn’t want to pay his fair share in taxes would say.

Tax the rich.

The student loan system is increasingly rigged against borrowers.

Trump is cutting federal options and gutting the CFPB, pushing people toward private lenders with even fewer protections.

More and more, it's a real heads-they-win, tails-you-lose situation for working families.

Anybody can wave their hands and claim they'll lower costs.

Voters are done with vague promises. They deserve real plans and specific steps to cut child care and utility bills.

That's how we build credibility—and that’s what I’m fighting for.

Jeff, how about a two-cent wealth tax?


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Bezos on CNBC: "You could double the taxes I pay, and it's not gonna help that teacher in Queens. I promise you."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2057072866542190941#m

Congratulations to @VoteBobBrooks! 

When we fight like hell for working people, we win.


Bob Brooks (@VoteBobBrooks)

I am honored to be the Democratic nominee for PA-07. 

On to November.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/VoteBobBrooks/status/2056952204364312636#m
Bottom line: The president should not be able to own and trade stocks. Or the vice president. Or members of Congress.
